title: AWS Lambda consumer for self-managed Apache Kafka with OAuth through AWS IAM (Node.js)
description: Node.js AWS Lambda function that consumes from self-managed Apache Kafka with SASL/OAUTHBEARER, using web identity tokens issued by AWS IAM.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Self-managed Apache Kafka with SASL/OAUTHBEARER using tokens issued by AWS IAM: through IAM outbound identity federation, the event source mapping obtains a web identity token for the function's execution role (IAM_OAUTHBEARER_AUTH), with no identity provider or secret.

The AWS CloudFormation template KafkaBrokersClientEC2.yaml creates the Kafka cluster and an Amazon EC2 client instance; the AWS Lambda function and its event source are deployed with AWS SAM or the AWS CLI.
The function decodes each Kafka record, logs it to Amazon CloudWatch Logs, and writes its fields to Amazon DynamoDB.
For detailed deployment instructions, see the README.md.
